seo.description: Portfolio of Nour Wehbi, a journalism and digital media student in Beirut working across reporting, photography, video and multimedia storytelling.

hero.intro: A curious mind who captures stories through words, visuals and emotion — because every voice has a story worth telling.

aboutTeaser.title: Reporting that bridges traditional craft and digital platforms
aboutTeaser.body: I am a journalism and digital media student at Al-Maaref University with hands-on experience in news writing, photography, video features and social media content. My work focuses on delivering engaging, credible and visually compelling stories.

workTeaser.title: Words, frames and moving images
workTeaser.body: A body of work spanning long-form reporting, photo essays, documentary video and multimedia projects produced across Lebanon.
